heading: Three steps from prompt to pull request
description: Helix turns intent into shipped code through a transparent, three-step orchestration loop you can audit at every stage.

steps.title: Describe the goal
steps.description: Write a sentence about what you want. Helix turns it into a structured plan with explicit success criteria and the files it expects to touch.
bullets: Scope preview before any code runs

steps.title: Decompose & orchestrate
steps.description: Helix breaks the goal into atomic units, orders them by dependency, and runs them in parallel where it can — gating each one on the previous unit's verification.
bullets: Hard gate on types, tests, and lint

steps.title: Review & ship
steps.description: Each unit lands as a small pull request with a clear description and a replayable run log. Merge the ones you want, revert the ones you don't.
